descriptor.retrieval_description: Small spherical citrus fruit with a textured, dimpled organic rind and continuous curved lateral surface. The intended contact region is clean and dry with gently curved local geometry.
descriptor.contact_region: Opposing lateral exterior surfaces of the citrus fruit along the centered grasp band.
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Clean, dry, and textured with natural dimples.
descriptor.local_geometry: Convex, continuously curved spherical surface without sharp ridges or seams.
descriptor.uncertainty: The exact tactile compliance of the fruit interior cannot be verified from the visual data alone.
